questions.q: In R.C. Hutchinson's essay, who was the chief character in the Dublin play?

questions.q: How did Mahadevi Verma know Gillu was hungry?

questions.q: According to Satyajit Ray, what does an Indian film need most?
options: Original Indian themes and creative storytelling
questions.explanation: Ray stressed producing films reflecting real Indian life.

questions.explanation: Alexander Aris accepted the award in Oslo on her behalf.

questions.q: In 'Once Upon a Time', what answer did the old blind woman give the visitors?
options: 'It is in your hands whether the bird is alive or dead.'
questions.explanation: She wisely placed the moral responsibility on the young visitors.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Tolstoy's story, why were the adults arguing violently?
options: Over the muddy water splashed on Akoulya's dress by Malasha

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: She is adept _____ painting.
questions.explanation: 'Adept' takes preposition 'in'.

questions.q: According to Alexander Pope, what makes a man happy?
options: A small paternal land, health, and peace of mind
questions.explanation: Pope praises simple rural life on inherited land.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What happens to a polythene bag when it is left in the environment?
options: It remains buried without melting and pollutes the soil
questions.explanation: Polythene never degrades naturally and pollutes the earth.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Vidyapati's poem, how thin has Radha become due to grief?
options: Thinner than the crescent moon on the first night
questions.explanation: Her extreme sorrow makes her thinner than a crescent moon.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In 'The Empty Heart', what was the man's downfall?
options: His unending greed for more gold
questions.explanation: His desire to fill the 7th pot killed him with anxiety.

questions.q: In 'Koel', what element of nature causes the cuckoo's heart to sing painfully?
options: The green leaves and mango blossoms
questions.explanation: Mango blossoms trigger her passionate, painful song of love.

questions.q: In Devkota's poem, what is the porter carrying up the mountain?
options: A fifty-seven kilo heavy load on his back
questions.explanation: He carries a 57 kg load up a steep, icy mountain trail.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Walter de la Mare's poem, what did Martha do while telling stories?
options: She sat leaning her chin on her hands
questions.explanation: Martha leaned her chin on her hands in a quiet hazel valley.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Premchand's 'January Night', who was Jabra?
questions.explanation: Jabra was Halku's faithful pet dog.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Why did Halku give his three saved rupees to the landlord?
options: To settle his debt tax rather than face insults
questions.explanation: He surrendered his blanket savings to avoid landlord's abuses.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Chekhov's 'The Bet', how much money did the lawyer forfeit by escaping early?
questions.explanation: He renounced the entire 2 million rubles prize.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Galsworthy's 'Quality', what killed the older Gessler brother?
options: Slow starvation due to loss of boot business
questions.explanation: Starvation and relentless work led to his death.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: In Mansfield's 'Sun and Moon', what were Sun and Moon watching?
options: Their parents hosting a grand evening party for guests
questions.explanation: The children observed their parents' fancy dinner party.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: 'I _____ him two days ago.'
questions.explanation: Time adverb 'two days ago' takes simple past 'saw'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: 'She _____ in this school for five years.'
questions.explanation: Duration 'for five years' takes Present Perfect Continuous.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct tense: 'The patient _____ before the doctor arrived.'
questions.explanation: Earlier past action takes Past Perfect 'had died'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to passive: 'People speak English all over the world.'
options: English is spoken all over the world.
questions.explanation: General active 'People speak X' becomes 'X is spoken'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to passive: 'Who wrote the Ramayana?'
options: By whom was the Ramayana written?
questions.explanation: 'Who wrote X?' becomes 'By whom was X written?'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to passive: 'Please sit down.'
options: You are requested to sit down.
questions.explanation: Imperative polite request becomes 'You are requested to + V1'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to active: 'The work will be finished by me tomorrow.'
options: I will finish the work tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Future passive 'will be finished by me' becomes 'I will finish'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: Neither of the boys _____ present yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Neither' takes singular past verb 'was'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: The news _____ true.
questions.explanation: Uncountable noun 'News' takes singular verb 'is'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct verb: A pair of shoes _____ lying in the corner.
questions.explanation: 'A pair of...' takes singular verb 'is'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to indirect: He said, 'I am reading a book.'
options: He said that he was reading a book.
questions.explanation: Direct 'I am reading' changes to 'he was reading'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to indirect: She said to me, 'Where do you live?'
options: She asked me where I lived.
She told me where I live.
She asked me where do I live.
questions.explanation: Question 'Where do you live?' becomes 'where I lived'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: Please pay attention _____ what I say.
questions.explanation: 'Attention' is followed by preposition 'to'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He died _____ malaria.
questions.explanation: Dying of a disease takes preposition 'of'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He is addicted _____ playing cards.
questions.explanation: 'Addicted' takes preposition 'to'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He agreed _____ my proposal.
questions.explanation: Agreeing to an idea/proposal takes 'to' (agreeing with a person).
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He agreed _____ me on this matter.
questions.explanation: Agreeing with a person takes 'with'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Which is the correct spelling of the word meaning 'lodging facility'?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is A-C-C-O-M-M-O-D-A-T-I-O-N.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct preposition: He divided the property _____ his two sons.
questions.explanation: 'Between' is used for two sons.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Which is the correct spelling of the word meaning 'special event'?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is O-C-C-A-S-I-O-N.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: He is _____ European.
questions.explanation: European starts with consonant sound /jʊərəˈpiːən/, so it takes 'a'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: She is _____ M.A. in English.
questions.explanation: M.A. starts with vowel sound /ɛm/, so it takes 'an'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: _____ Sun shines brightly.
questions.explanation: Unique celestial bodies take article 'The'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the correct article: Man is _____ mortal.
questions.explanation: Man in general sense takes no article ('Man is mortal').
questions.subject: English

options: He will go to his village tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Simple future tense translation.

questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the antonym of 'Advance':

questions.q: Choose the antonym of 'Freedom':

questions.subject: English

questions.q: One word substitution: 'A person who looks on the bright side of things.'
questions.explanation: An optimist looks at the positive side.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: One word substitution: 'A person who looks on the dark side of things.'
questions.explanation: A pessimist looks at the negative side.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the idiom 'Better late than never' mean?
options: It is better to arrive or do something late than not at all
questions.explanation: Doing something late is better than never doing it.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the idiom 'Bury the hatchet' mean?
options: To end a quarrel and make peace
questions.explanation: 'Bury the hatchet' means to forget past conflicts and make peace.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the idiom 'Hit the nail on the head' mean?
options: To describe exactly what is right or true
questions.explanation: Saying something completely accurate is hitting the nail on head.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: What does the idiom 'Through thick and thin' mean?
options: Through good times and bad times / In all circumstances
questions.explanation: Supporting someone in all circumstances is supporting through thick and thin.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Correct the sentence: 'She is more senior than me.'
options: She is more senior to me.
questions.explanation: 'Senior' takes preposition 'to' without 'more'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Correct the sentence: 'One of the student is absent.'
options: One of the students is absent.
questions.explanation: 'One of + plural noun' takes singular verb ('One of the students is').
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Correct the sentence: 'He gave me many advices.'
options: He gave me much advice (or many pieces of advice).
questions.explanation: 'Advice' is uncountable and does not take 's'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Correct the sentence: 'I am knowing the answer.'
questions.explanation: Stative verb 'know' is not used in continuous tense for present state.

questions.q: Which word correctly spells the term for 'giving permission'?
questions.explanation: Correct spelling is A-L-L-O-W-A-N-C-E.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Which word correctly spells the term for 'feeling of joy'?
questions.explanation: Correct spelling is P-L-E-A-S-U-R-E.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Translate into English: 'हम कल कहाँ जाएँगे?'
questions.explanation: Interrogative future tense sentence.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Translate into English: 'क्या आप तैरना जानते हैं?'
options: Do you know how to swim?
questions.explanation: Knowing a skill is translated as 'Do you know how to swim?'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Translate into English: 'पेड़ से फल गिरते हैं।'
questions.explanation: Plural subject takes 'fall from the tree'.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the synonym of 'Triumph':

questions.q: Choose the antonym of 'Guilty':
questions.explanation: Guilty is opposite to innocent.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Choose the antonym of 'Miser':
